text: Ko onon yo ɓen gomɗimɓe Allah, ɓe jokki sari'a Makko on, wata on aditor yeeso Allah e Nulaaɗo Makko, konngol maa kuugal. Huliron kadi Allah, ñemtinirgol yamaruyeeji Makko ɗin e woɗɗitagol haɗaaɗi Makko ɗin. Pellet, Allah ko Nanoowo haala mon, Annduɗo golle mon. Huunde e mun laawotaako Mo. Ma O yoɓitiroy on ɗi.
